# Compose training and validation sets 

## Definition of scenarios

Genomic predictions scenarios:

- **wBP**: within each BP, the nursery being considered as a breeding program here.

- **acBP**: across each pair of BP, the nursery being considered as a breeding program here. The training set is composed of one breeding program. For example, NDSU -> SDSU, NDSU -> URN/URSN, ...We will extract more specifically how well the nursery is predicting the individual breeding program.

- **acAllBP**: across BP but using data from all other breeding program in the training set: NDSU + SDSU + URN/URSN -> MSU for example.

- **nursBP**: training using nursery genotypes from the breeding program to be predicted.

For all the predictions, record the training/validation set size and the genetic relatedness.

Questions:

- Need a better control of training/validation set sizes with resampling?
- Test training set optimization?
- Study the contribution of parameters to the predictive ability?

## Prediction parameters

Cross-validation parameters:
```{r CV_params}
dim(pheno) ## 3270 x 11
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(pheno$GID)))
## params:
nreps <- 10 ## number of cross-validation repetitions
nfolds <- 10 ## number of cross-validation folds
```

# Define functions

```{r}
calcRel <- function(gid.train, gid.valid, GRM){
  rel.mat <- GRM[gid.train, gid.valid]
  summ.rel <- quantile(x=c(rel.mat), probs=seq(0,1,0.1))
  return(summ.rel)
}

getMostRel <- function(rel.mat, thresh.val){
  mostRel <- data.frame()
  for(i in 1:nrow(rel.mat)){
    for(j in 1:ncol(rel.mat)){
      if(rel.mat[i,j] > thresh.val){
        mostRel <- rbind(mostRel, rel.mat[i,j])
        rownames(mostRel)[nrow(mostRel)] <- paste(rownames(rel.mat)[i], colnames(rel.mat)[j], sep="-")
      }
    }
  }
  return(mostRel)
}

allFreq <- function(geno){
  apply(geno, 2, function(x) {
    counts <- tabulate(x+1)
    max(counts) / length(x)
  })
}



RogerDistance <- function(geno1,geno2){
  ## Roger's distance between two groups of genotypes
  stopifnot(ncol(geno1) == ncol(geno2))
  AF1 <- allFreq(geno1)
  AF2 <- allFreq(geno2)
  n_SNP <- ncol(geno1)
  R_dist <- sum(sqrt((AF1-AF2)^2))/n_SNP
  return(R_dist)
}
#Rdist=RogerDistance(geno1=geno[1:100,], geno2=geno[200:350,])
```


## wBP scenario

wBP: within each BP, the nursery being considered as a breeding program here.
```{r apply_gp_all_wBP}
calcRels <- data.frame()
for(bp in BPs){
  gid.bp <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% bp]
  genoBP=geno[gid.bp,]
  phenoBP=pheno[match(gid.bp,pheno$GID),]
  ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations
  traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
  ## calculate genetic relatedness training vs. validation set cross-validation
  for(tr in traits.50obs){
    pheno_tr <- stats::na.omit(phenoBP[, c("GID", tr)])
    inds <- intersect(pheno_tr$GID, rownames(genoBP))
    for(r in 1:nreps){
      folds <- getFolds(index=length(inds), nb.folds=nfolds, seed=r+57425)
      calcRelsR <- map_dfr(1:nfolds, \(fold){
        gid.valid <- inds[folds[[fold]]]
        gid.train <- setdiff(inds, gid.valid)
        #summ.rel <- calcRel(gid.train, gid.valid, GRM)
        Rdist <- RogerDistance(geno1=geno[gid.train,], geno2=geno[gid.valid,])
        return(data.frame(trainSetBP=bp,
                          validSetBP=bp,
                          scenario="wBP",
                          trait=tr,
                          nb.genos.TS=length(gid.train),
                          nb.genos.VS=length(gid.valid),
                          Roger_distance=Rdist,
                          rep=r,
                          fold=fold)
               # quantiles=names(summ.rel),
               # values=as.numeric(summ.rel))
        )
      })
      calcRels <- rbind(calcRelsR, calcRels)
    }
  } 
}
## summarize over folds and rep
# calcRels <- calcRels |> 
#   group_by(trainSetBP, validSetBP, scenario, trait, nb.genos.TS,
#            nb.genos.VS, quantiles) |>
#   summarize(values=mean(values),
#             nb.genos.TS=mean(nb.genos.TS),
#             nb.genos.VS=mean(nb.genos.VS), .groups="drop")

calcRels <- calcRels |> 
  group_by(trainSetBP, validSetBP, scenario, trait, nb.genos.TS,
           nb.genos.VS) |>
  summarize(Roger_distance=mean(Roger_distance),
            nb.genos.TS=mean(nb.genos.TS),
            nb.genos.VS=mean(nb.genos.VS), .groups="drop")
```

## acBP scenario

Training set: each breeding program.
Validation set: each breeding program except the training set.

```{r gp_acBP}
df.stats <- expand.grid(trainSet=BPs, validSet=BPs, stringsAsFactors = F)
df.stats <- filter(df.stats, !trainSet == validSet)
acBP <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:nrow(df.stats)){
  trainSetBP <- df.stats$trainSet[i]
  validSetBP <- df.stats$validSet[i]
  ## training set: each individual BP
  gid.train <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% trainSetBP]
  gid.valid <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% validSetBP]
  genoBP=geno[c(gid.train,gid.valid),]
  phenoBP=pheno[match(c(gid.train,gid.valid),pheno$GID),]
  ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations 
  traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
  
  for(tr in traits.50obs){
    gid.train.tr <- intersect(gid.train, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
    gid.valid.tr <- intersect(gid.valid, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
    #values <- calcRel(gid.train.tr, gid.valid.tr, GRM)
    Rdist <- RogerDistance(geno1=geno[gid.train.tr,], geno2=geno[gid.valid.tr,])
    df <- data.frame(trainSetBP=trainSetBP,
                     validSetBP=validSetBP,
                     scenario="acBP",
                     trait=tr,
                     Roger_distance=Rdist,
                     nb.genos.TS=length(gid.train.tr),
                     nb.genos.VS=length(gid.valid.tr)#,
                     # quantiles=names(values),
                     # values=as.numeric(values)
               
    )
    acBP <- plyr::rbind.fill(acBP, df)
    rm(df)
  }
}
```

### Since date

```{r acBP_NUR_sinceDate}
dates <- c("all",seq(2000,2020, by=5))
acBP_sinceDate <- data.frame()

for(validSetBP in BPs[!BPs %in% "NUR"]){
  for(date in dates){
    #write(paste0("since ",date,"\n"), stderr())
    if(date == "all"){
      pheno.sinceDate <- pheno |>
        filter(BP %in% "NUR") |> 
        bind_rows(pheno |> filter(!BP %in% "NUR"))
    }else{
      pheno.sinceDate <- pheno |>
        filter(BP %in% "NUR", GID %in% nur.info$GID[nur.info$FIRST_YEAR >= as.numeric(date)]) |> 
        bind_rows(pheno |> filter(!BP %in% "NUR"))
    }
    
    df.stats <- expand.grid(trainSet="NUR",stringsAsFactors = F)
    trainSetBP <- "NUR"
    ## training set: NUR
    gid.train <- pheno.sinceDate$GID[pheno.sinceDate$BP %in% trainSetBP]
    gid.valid <- pheno.sinceDate$GID[pheno.sinceDate$BP %in% validSetBP]
    
    genoBP=geno.sc[c(gid.train,gid.valid),]
    phenoBP=pheno.sinceDate[match(c(gid.train,gid.valid),pheno.sinceDate$GID),]
    
    ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations 
    traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
    ## subselect traits in the validation set as well
    traits.50obs <- traits.50obs[which(colSums(
      !is.na(pheno[match(gid.valid,pheno$GID),traits.50obs])) > 50)]
    
    for(tr in traits.50obs){
      gid.train.tr <- intersect(gid.train, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
      gid.valid.tr <- intersect(gid.valid, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
      #values <- calcRel(gid.train.tr, gid.valid.tr, GRM)
      Rdist <- RogerDistance(geno1=geno[gid.train.tr,], geno2=geno[gid.valid.tr,])
      df <- data.frame(trainSetBP=trainSetBP,
                       validSetBP=validSetBP,
                       scenario="acBP_sinceDate",
                       date=date,
                       trait=tr,
                       Roger_distance=Rdist,
                       nb.genos.TS=length(gid.train.tr),
                       nb.genos.VS=length(gid.valid.tr)#,
                       # quantiles=names(values),
                       # values=as.numeric(values)
                       
      )
      acBP_sinceDate <- plyr::rbind.fill(acBP_sinceDate, df)
      rm(df)
    }
  }
}
calcRels <- plyr::rbind.fill(calcRels, acBP_sinceDate)
```



### URN/URSN separately

Calculate genetic distance with URN and URSN with BP separately
```{r}
df.stats <- expand.grid(trainSet=c("URN","URSN"), validSet=BPs, stringsAsFactors = F)
acBP_NUR <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:nrow(df.stats)){
  trainSetBP <- df.stats$trainSet[i]
  validSetBP <- df.stats$validSet[i]
  ## training set: each individual BP
  gid.train <- intersect(pheno$GID, nur.info$GID[nur.info$NURSERY %in% trainSetBP])
  gid.valid <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% validSetBP]
  genoBP=geno[c(gid.train,gid.valid),]
  phenoBP=pheno[match(c(gid.train,gid.valid),pheno$GID),]
  ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations 
  traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
  
  for(tr in traits.50obs){
    gid.train.tr <- intersect(gid.train, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
    gid.valid.tr <- intersect(gid.valid, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
    #values <- calcRel(gid.train.tr, gid.valid.tr, GRM)
    Rdist <- RogerDistance(geno1=geno[gid.train.tr,], geno2=geno[gid.valid.tr,])
    df <- data.frame(trainSetBP=trainSetBP,
                     validSetBP=validSetBP,
                     scenario="acBP_NUR",
                     trait=tr,
                     Roger_distance=Rdist,
                     nb.genos.TS=length(gid.train.tr),
                     nb.genos.VS=length(gid.valid.tr)#,
                     # quantiles=names(values),
                     # values=as.numeric(values)
    )
    acBP_NUR <- plyr::rbind.fill(acBP_NUR, df)
    rm(df)
  }
}
```

## acAllBP scenario

acAllBP: across BP but using data from all other breeding program in the training set: NDSU + SDSU + URN/URSN -> MSU for example.


```{r gp-acAllBP}
acAllBP <- data.frame()
for(bp in BPs){
  ## training set: all other breeding program /data
  gid.train <- pheno$GID[!pheno$BP %in% bp]
  gid.valid <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% bp]
  ## mask the phenotype traits as NA for the validation set
  ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations
  traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
  for(tr in traits.50obs){
    gid.train.tr <- intersect(gid.train, pheno$GID[!is.na(pheno[, tr])])
    gid.valid.tr <- intersect(gid.valid, pheno$GID[!is.na(pheno[, tr])])
    #values <- calcRel(gid.train.tr, gid.valid.tr, GRM)
    Rdist <- RogerDistance(geno1=geno[gid.train.tr,], geno2=geno[gid.valid.tr,])
    df <- data.frame(trainSetBP="AllOtherBP",
                     validSetBP=bp,
                     scenario="acAllBP",
                     trait=tr,
                     Roger_distance=Rdist,
                     nb.genos.TS=length(gid.train.tr),
                     nb.genos.VS=length(gid.valid.tr)
    )
    acAllBP <- plyr::rbind.fill(acAllBP, df)
  }
}
calcRels <- plyr::rbind.fill(calcRels, acAllBP)
```




## nursBP scenario

nursBP: training using nursery genotypes from the breeding program to be predicted.

```{r gp-nursBP}
nursBP <- data.frame()
for(bp in BPs[!BPs %in% "NUR"]){
  
  ## validation set: each individual BP (no nursery)
  gid.valid <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% bp]
  ## training set: NUR BP
  gid.train <- intersect(gid.nur, nur.info$GID[nur.info$SOURCE %in% bp])
  phenoBP <- pheno[match(c(gid.train, gid.valid), pheno$GID),] 
  ## mask the phenotype traits as NA for the validation set
  ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations
  traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
  
  for(tr in traits.50obs){
    gid.train.tr <- intersect(gid.train, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
    gid.valid.tr <- intersect(gid.valid, phenoBP$GID[!is.na(phenoBP[, tr])])
    if(length(gid.train.tr) > 50 &length(gid.valid.tr) >50){
      
      # values <- calcRel(gid.train.tr, gid.valid.tr, GRM)
      # mostRel <- getMostRel(rel.mat=GRM[gid.train.tr, gid.valid.tr], thresh.val=values["90%"])
      # mostRel[order(mostRel[,1], decreasing = T)[1:20],, drop=F]
      Rdist=RogerDistance(geno1=geno[gid.train.tr,], geno2=geno[gid.valid.tr,])
      df <- data.frame(trainSetBP=paste0("NUR-",bp),
                       validSetBP=bp,
                       scenario="nursBP",
                       trait=tr,
                       Roger_distance=Rdist,
                       nb.genos.TS=length(gid.train.tr),
                       nb.genos.VS=length(gid.valid.tr)
                       # quantiles=names(values),
                       # values=as.numeric(values)
      )
      nursBP <- plyr::rbind.fill(nursBP, df)
    }
  }
}
calcRels <- plyr::rbind.fill(calcRels, nursBP)
```



## Genetic distance for URN and URSN separately

```{r}
acBP_NUR |> 
  group_by(trainSetBP, validSetBP) |> 
  filter(!validSetBP %in% "NUR") |> 
  summarize(meanRdist=mean(Roger_distance, na.rm=T)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=validSetBP, y=meanRdist, fill=trainSetBP))+
  geom_col(position="dodge")+
  labs(x="Validation set breeding program",
       y="Roger's distance",
       color="Training set nursery")+
  theme_minimal(base_size=13)+
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2))+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top",
        legend.text=element_text(margin=margin(r=0.1)))
ggsave(here("output","figures",
            "GP-genetic-relatedness-Rdist_URN-vs-URSN_BP.png"),
       width=9, height=6, scale=0.8)
```

# Genetic contribution URN/URSN


```{r}
library(nnls)

## released cultivar
cult <- c("NUR-731")

gid.urn <- nur.info$GID[nur.info$NURSERY %in% "URN" & !nur.info$GID %in% cult]
gid.ursn <- nur.info$GID[nur.info$NURSERY %in% "URSN" & !nur.info$GID %in% cult]

A <- t(geno.sc[c(gid.urn, gid.ursn),])
# A.urn <- colMeans(geno.sc[gid.urn, ]) # Unique URN signature
# A.ursn <- colMeans(geno.sc[gid.ursn, ]) # Unique URSN signature
# A.oth <- rep(0, ncol(geno.sc))         # Unexplained Background (All Zeros)
## Combine the signatures into a matrix

#A <- cbind(A.urn, A.ursn, A.oth)
Y <- geno.sc[cult,]


# 3. Apply the Sum-to-One Constraint Trick across all individuals
weight <- 10000
A_constrained <- rbind(A, rep(weight, ncol(A)))
Y_constrained <- c(Y, weight)

reg_result <- nnls(A_constrained, Y_constrained)
individual_weights <- reg_result$x
names(individual_weights) <- c(gid.urn, gid.ursn)

## Aggregate the weights by Set
(urn_contribution <- sum(individual_weights[gid.urn]))
(ursn_contribution <- sum(individual_weights[gid.ursn]))
picked_parents <- individual_weights[individual_weights > 0.01]
print(sort(picked_parents, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5])
```
